scenarios.name: Dock the floating ribbon to the left

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active and the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
chooses Dock to Left from the floating title menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the left
the model browser appears to the right of the ribbon
the user chooses Top from the docked ribbon tab menu
the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport
